Spaghetti Carbonara

sending you the real recipe like I promised, none of that cream nonsense

serves 2

ingredients:
200g spaghetti
100g guanciale (pancetta if you can't find it), cut into small strips
2 whole eggs
2 extra egg yolks
50g pecorino romano, finely grated, plus more for serving
black pepper, a lot of it
salt for the pasta water

method:
put the pasta water on to boil, salt it well.

while that's coming up to a boil, cook the guanciale in a cold pan over medium heat, letting the fat render out slowly, until it's crisp. turn off the heat.

whisk the eggs, egg yolks, pecorino and a generous amount of black pepper together in a bowl.

cook time: 18 minutes covers the pasta boil and finishing it in the pan, most of that is just waiting on the water and the noodles.

drain the pasta, saving a cup of the water, and tip it straight into the pan with the guanciale. toss it around off the heat for a minute so the pan isn't screaming hot.

pour in the egg mixture, tossing constantly and adding splashes of the pasta water, until it turns into a glossy sauce that coats every strand. if it looks like scrambled eggs, the pan was too hot, not the recipe's fault.

serve right away with more pecorino and pepper on top.
